name: J. Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Rio'
story_html: The J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Rio' takes its name from the reggaeton artist's son. The legacy silhouette carries a black leather upper with grey elephant print overlays at the forefoot and heel. Gradient accents in Solar Flare and Total Crimson Abyss coat the back tab, marked with Nike Air branding on the left foot and J Balvin's smiley face logo on the right. The sunset colors are repeated on the rear of the polyurethane midsole, supported by a red-tinged translucent rubber outsole.
